intro.en: Farming, plants and animals in more detail, and the proverbs the countryside left in the language.

texto.en:
**Farming.** **El campesino** or **el agricultor** **siembra** las **semillas**, **riega**, **cultiva** and, months later, **recoge la cosecha**. Smaller plots: **un huerto** (a kitchen garden) and **una huerta** (a larger irrigated area, as in Valencia or Murcia). Machines: **el tractor**.

**Animals.** **Una granja** has **gallinas**, **cerdos** and **vacas**. **El ganado** is all the animals raised for food. **Un rebaño de ovejas** is looked after by **un pastor**. Adjectives: **ganadero**, **agrícola**, **forestal**.

**Character of animals.** **Manso** or **dócil** against **feroz** or **bravo**: **un toro bravo**. **Doméstico** against **salvaje**. **Un perro callejero** is a stray.

**Plants.** A plant **brota** (sprouts), **florece**, **da fruto** and the fruit **madura**. Parts: **la raíz**, **el tallo**, **la hoja**, **el pétalo**, **la semilla**, **el polen**. Kinds: **un arbusto**, **una seta**, **un alga**; **silvestre** (growing wild), **venenoso**, **trepador** (climbing). At home they live in **macetas**.

**Wild and silvestre.** Animals are **salvajes**; plants and fruit are **silvestres**: **flores silvestres**, **frutos silvestres**.

**Protection.** **Una especie autóctona** is native. **Una especie protegida.** **En peligro de extinción.**

**The country in the language.**

- **Quien siembra vientos recoge tempestades.** (You reap what you sow.)
- **Cada oveja con su pareja.** (Like with like.)
- **Ser la oveja negra.** (To be the black sheep.)
- **Estar verde.** (To be unripe; of a person, inexperienced.)
- **A buenas horas, mangas verdes.** (Too late to be any use.)

frases.es: Anselmo tiene setenta y cuatro años y es el último pastor de un valle en el que llegó a haber treinta rebaños.
frases.en: Anselmo is seventy-four and is the last shepherd in a valley where there were once as many as thirty flocks.
analisis: el último pastor de un valle
en el que llegó a haber

frases.es: Cada primavera, cuando florecen los arbustos, sube con sus ovejas a los pastos de la montaña.
frases.en: Every spring, when the bushes come into flower, he goes up with his sheep to the mountain pastures.
analisis: a los pastos de la montaña

frases.es: Conoce cada planta silvestre por su nombre y sabe cuáles curan y cuáles son venenosas.
frases.en: He knows every wild plant by name and knows which ones heal and which are poisonous.

frases.es: Sus hijos se marcharon a la ciudad, y él no les reprocha que no quisieran una vida tan dura.
frases.en: His children left for the city, and he does not reproach them for not wanting such a hard life.

frases.es: Lo que le preocupa es que, sin ganado que coma la hierba, el monte se llena de maleza y arde con más facilidad.
frases.en: What worries him is that, without livestock to eat the grass, the hillside fills with scrub and burns more easily.
analisis: Lo que le preocupa es que

frases.es: También ha vuelto el lobo, una especie protegida a la que no guarda rencor, aunque le haya matado más de una oveja.
frases.en: The wolf has also returned, a protected species against which he bears no grudge, even though it has killed more than one of his sheep.
analisis: a la que no guarda rencor

frases.es: Dice que el lobo hace lo que le toca, y que los verdaderos animales feroces viven en los despachos.
frases.en: He says the wolf does what it is meant to do, and that the truly fierce animals live in offices.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what worries Anselmo most?

Without livestock the hillside burns mor.en: El monte se llena de maleza y arde con más facilidad.

bloques.correcta: Without livestock the hillside burns more easily

pregunta.en: According to the text, how does Anselmo feel about the wolf?

He has never seen one.en: It has killed some of his sheep.

pregunta.en: Complete: in spring the almond trees flower.

maduran.en: Madurar is to ripen, said of fruit.

pregunta.en: Es la oveja negra de la familia means…

bloques.correcta: He is the odd one out, the one who causes trouble

texto.en: The wind sows the storms that are gathered.

explicacion.en: The proverb warns that bad actions bring worse consequences.

texto.en: Whoever sows in the wind harvests early.

bloques.frase: Este año la cosecha ha sido mejor que la del año pasado

traduccion.en: This year the harvest has been better than last year's.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an essay on the depopulation of the countryside: causes, consequences and possible solutions.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud the life of someone you know who lives or lived from the land.
